title: Origin story: Don Quixote
description: Alonso Quixano, a country gentleman maddened by romances of chivalry, renamed himself Don Quixote, took the peasant Sancho Panza as squire, and rode out to right wrongs — tilting at windmills he took for giants, freeing galley slaves, and dying at last with his sanity restored and his idealism intact.
